article.title: AI-driven disinformation raises concerns amid PH’s growing digital economy
article.description: The increasing use of artificial intelligence (AI) in online propaganda campaigns has underscored the need for stronger digital literacy and cybersecurity measures in the Philippines as the country accelerates its digital transformation.
article.author: Rissa Silvestre

instagram_caption:
As the PH digital economy grows, hindi lang tech stack natin ang nag-a-upgrade. Pati ang mga online propaganda at fake news, may AI upgrade na rin.

Alamin kung paano binabago ng AI ang disinformation sa bansa at kung bakit mas kailangan natin ng matinding digital literacy at cybersecurity ngayon.

I-share mo 'to sa barkada mo para sabay-sabay tayong maging ligtas online.

#CybersecurityPH #DigitalLiteracy #AIGovernance #TechPH #VibeCoders

Source: https://newsbytes.ph/2026/06/13/ai-driven-disinformation-raises-concerns-amid-phs-growing-digital-economy/
